Priya S: quick sync  I'm landing a small refresh to the HelloMicro quickstart — focus: auth snippet clarity and minimal first-deploy steps. PR #4510. Can someone sanity-check Windows and CI notes?
Noah R: can do. What's the main confusion?
Priya S: two quick things: 1) env var name inconsistency (API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY) across README and sample code; 2) CI snippet in README leaks a long workflow — want to replace with a tiny 4-line example that only shows how to set REDWOOD_API_KEY and call `redwood start`.
Noah R: agree on canonical REDWOOD_API_KEY. For Windows include PowerShell session example: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<key>"; npm run start`. Avoid setx.
Marie L: I'll do a language pass after changes. Also suggest adding a one-line troubleshooting tip about missing envs rather than a long troubleshoot section.
doc-bot: PR #4510 labeled: docs, quickstart
Priya S: plan: I'll normalize env names, swap CI to minimal workflow, add PowerShell one-liner, and Marie will copyedit. Target merge: EOD today. Thanks! :sparkles:
